Name: Oku's Basic Bathroom Furniture - AT
Author: okubunny
Description:
[size=5][b][center][font=Tahoma][color=#ea9999]˚୨୧⋆｡˚ ⋆ Oku's Basic Bathroom Pack ˚୨୧⋆｡˚ ⋆[/color][/font][/center][/b][/size]
[center]
[size=2]Working as of November 2024 - Please leave a comment if you are experiencing a bug[/size][/center]
[size=4]I'm excited to release my [i]first[/i] furniture pack! yippee! (˶˃ ᵕ ˂˶) .ᐟ.ᐟ ˚୨୧⋆｡˚ ⋆

[/size]This mod adds 20+ pieces of furniture to alternative textures. There are over 100+ variations, so go wild!

[color=#f4cccc][size=3][b]This pack contains:

[/b][/size][/color]- 2 toilets (1 floating and 1 standard)

- A fully modular shower (mix and match to make your own!)
   - Glass shower door
   - Shower back
   - Shower drain (2x1 and 2x2 versions)

- bathroom sink (two can be connected to make a double sink)
- 5 two-tile mirrors
- 7 one-tile mirrors
- bathtub
- mini trash can 

[color=#f4cccc][size=3][b]All items have multiple swatches (˶˃ ᵕ ˂˶) .ᐟ.ᐟ[/b][/size][/color]


[b][color=#f4cccc]How to get it working:
[/color][/b]
- Have smapi installed
- Download Alternative textures if you don't have it
- Extract my mod file and put it in your Mods folder
- Buy paint bucket from robin or use the Happy Home Designer mod (which I personally recommend)

[color=#f4cccc][b]Planned updates (make sure you track this mod!)[/b][/color]

- add new bathroom rugs
- add a circle mirror option with no strings
- add a fully rounded bathtub

I'll also take any suggestions you have :3

[color=#f4cccc][b]Known issues / Things to keep in mind:[/b][/color]
[size=1]- [s]The sinks don't connect when in sideways view[/s]. 
- [s]The regular shower is away from the wall 
[/s][/size][b]Use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] mod to move them better![/b]

I'm new to modding so let me know if there's any issues with the mod!

feel free to edit the png files for personal use, I don't mind.

[size=4][color=#fff2cc]donations are definitely appreciated! -->[/color] [url=https://ko-fi.com/bunnyoku]Kofi


[/url][b][color=#d9ead3]Credits (and mods that I think you should also download): ﻿[/color]

[/b][/size]- Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url] for letting me take inspiration from their bathtub item from their [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]Rattan Furniture Pack!
[/url]- I got the idea for a modular shower from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25684]Farmerbeans's Bathroom Furniture [/url]mod. Thank you! I also use their bathroom mats in the preview images.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982]Aster's Adorable Cottage Bathroom and Furniture[/url] mod gave me the idea to use the bed item as a shower. Thank you!
- I used [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/orangeblossom7?gameId=1303]Orangeblossom's[/url] furniture a lot in the preview images <3 specifically their wallpapers, basic windows, carpets, and greenhouse set
- The pink rugs in the preview images are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12288]Shardust's pastel furniture[/url] mod
